**Covered Procedure:** Met  
Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) is a covered bariatric procedure.

This authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please schedule the procedure within this timeframe. Contact our office if you need an extension or have questions.
